summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.1 - Denim Wash Effect Preset ## Introduction to the Water-Washing Effect Preset This video introduces the water-washing effect preset function of the Bullfrog. It can achieve the expression of a real Bullfrog. From the 2025.1 version, the material type has been added to the Diningbo type. ## Adjusting the Water-Washing Process Using this function, you can adjust the water-washing process preset and various parameters to show various water-washing effects. This function is based on the Bullfrog texture and basic texture diagram for water-washing. ### Selecting the Bullfrog Fabric We will use this Bullfrog to show the function. First, select the Bullfrog fabric in the object window. Then, in the property editor below, change the material type to Diningbo. When the material type is set to Diningbo, you can see that the water-washing process type option will appear below. Use the water-washing type to select the Bullfrog cloth and preview the effect. According to the selected water-washing type, the detailed properties or parameters below will change accordingly. ## Overview of Water-Washing Types Next, we will quickly understand the different water-washing types that can be displayed through this picture. ### Default Water-Washing Type The default setting is for the water-washing type, which refers to the original Bullfrog cloth that has not been water-washed. Only the texture diagram of the original fabric is applied. ### Diningbo Type The Diningbo type is the most basic water-washing process. It can evenly color and soften the fabric while retaining the original color of the Bullfrog to the maximum extent. ### Speed-Washing Type The speed-washing type can be applied through the light pattern. It can slightly fade the color and soften the fabric. ### Nature-Painting Effect The nature-painting effect simulates the appearance of fabric that has been worn many times, avoiding obvious discoloration. ### Dining-Washing Technique The Dining-washing technique adds floating friction to the fabric during the washing process, resulting in a nature-painting effect and forming a clear contrast pattern. ### Customized Dining-Washing Type Finally, the customized Dining-washing type supports the application of customized Dining-washing patterns, infinitely expanding the individualization of Dining-washing effects and achieving unique design expressions. ## Applying Dining-Washing Types Now, let's go back to the Dining-washing interface. We will apply the two Dining-washing types, Dining-washing and Dining-washing, to this Bullfrog and see how to adjust their parameters to show different Bullfrog Dining-washing effects. ### Changing the Dining-Washing Process Type First, in the property editor, change the Dining-washing process type to Dining-washing. You can see the Dining-washing effect of the entire pants in the 3D window. Click on the little triangle, and the Dining-washing pattern corresponding to the Dining-washing type will appear at the bottom. The basic pattern of the fabric integrates naturally, showcasing the Bullfrog Dining-washing effect. ### Customizing Dining-Washing Patterns If you do not use Dining-washing, you can also add the Dining-washing pattern you want. The Dining-washing process type will be automatically changed to user customized, allowing you to achieve the customized Dining-washing effect you desire. ## Detailed Properties of Dining-Washing Type Next, we will see the detailed properties of the selected Dining-washing type. ### Discoloration Intensity The first property is the discoloration intensity, which controls the overall intensity of the discoloration effect. Moving the slider to the right increases the value, making the contrast of the dark area of the pants more obvious. The maximum limit creates the feeling of wearing for a long time. ### Mixing Mode See the mixing mode below. Click on the dropdown menu to switch between various mixing options, such as normal, flat bottom, and green. These options determine how the Dining-washing effect blends with the fabric pattern of the Bullfrog. Specifically, the Dining-washing function can naturally increase the contrast, making the dark parts of the Dining-washing pattern darker and the bright parts brighter in the original Dining-washing pattern. ### Recommended Settings Due to the realistic simulation of the Dining-washing function, it is recommended to use the Dining-washing settings for the most natural and realistic effect. ### Absorption Depth and Width The absorption of the bottom number determines the depth and width of the Dining-washing effect absorbed by the fabric. Increasing this value increases the range of Dining-washing effects, creating a more natural and harmonious feel. ### Duration of the Wash The duration of the week adjusts the Dining-washing time. Increasing this value extends the Dining-washing time, allowing for more dye removal from the jeans, thereby revealing the overall color of the pants. ## Applying Lucy Fold for Realism To apply this option effectively, pre-apply Lucy fold in the corresponding area. Increasing the Dining-washing value will apply to the side of the pants, emphasizing the texture of the sewing wrinkle, making it darker and clearer. Conversely, lowering the number will blur the wrinkle. ## Changing to Rinsing Technique Next, change the water-washing technique to rinsing. After changing the water-washing type, the overall color of the pants becomes brighter, as if it has been rinsed with a chemical. The following detailed options differ from the previous model types. ### Rinsing Concentration First is the rinsing concentration, which sets the strength of the water-washing effect. As the number grows, the water-washing effect enhances, maximizing the rinsing effect and removing more dye from the cowhide cloth, making it brighter. ### Mixing Mode for Rinsing The rinsing mode is called soft light. The contrast of soft light is not as strong as the intense mode, allowing for a smooth integration with the original cowhide fabric. Different mixing options can be set to achieve varied water-washing effects even with the same water-washing type. ### Enhancing Detail Performance Finally, you can adjust other parameters, such as absorbency or creasing wear, to enhance detail performance. Especially on the pants of the rinsing pot, the water-washing effect can be added to the creasing area, showcasing a more three-dimensional discoloration effect that creates real wear and tear marks, rather than simple color discoloration. ## Conclusion To choose a different water-washing type, the initial adjustment parameters at the bottom will also vary, but the adjustment approach remains the same. Using the water-washing preset, you can select the desired water-washing type in the attribute editor and adjust the detailed attributes to present your cowhide fabric in a more realistic way. ```
